metadata.title: Ricci flows and bracket flows on twisted principal bundles
metadata.abstract: We show that Ricci flows of invariant metrics on twisted principal bundles with nilpotent fibres over \(S^1\) are immortal and type III. After normalisation and lift to the universal cover, a sequence of metrics converges in the Cheeger--Gromov topology to a homogeneous expanding Ricci soliton. The proof extends the bracket flow technique from homogeneous Ricci flows to invariant Ricci flows on twisted principal bundles.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对以S¹为底、幂零纤维的扭主丛上的不变度量，Ricci流全正时间存在且为Type III；归一化并提升到万有覆盖后，某序列在Cheeger–Gromov拓扑中收敛到齐性扩张Ricci孤立子。
analysis.breakthrough: 把齐性bracket flow方法扩展至此类不变但不必齐性的扭丛几何。
analysis.limitations: 需要不变初始度量、幂零纤维和S¹底；摘要只给归一化提升后的子列收敛，不是原紧空间上全时间唯一极限。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第4页§1.2明确区分：Theorem A/B证明未用AI，Theorem C/D证明由ChatGPT 5.6 Sol、6 Astra及6.1 Sol辅助，且无AI撰写文本。正面判定依据C/D证明辅助，非§1.1仅获工具访问资助；只记proofs，不能扩大成主定理全部证明、核心思想或写作贡献。
